account.title: Owner account and access
account.already: Authentication is already configured. Manage it in Settings → Sharing & integrations.
account.description: Protect the dashboard with an owner password, or run without authentication on a trusted network.

connection.title: Frigate & MQTT connection
connection.save_failed: The connection settings could not be saved. Check the values and try again.
connection.mqtt_auth_hint: Enable this only when your broker requires a username and password.
connection.mqtt_password_saved: A saved password will be kept unless you enter a replacement.
connection.description: YA-WAMF hears about each bird from Frigate over MQTT, and fetches its snapshot from Frigate’s API. Enter both addresses, then test.
connection.frigate_auth_hint: If your Frigate requires a sign-in, set FRIGATE_AUTH_TOKEN in the environment YA-WAMF starts with, restart it, then test again.
connection.mqtt_fail: Could not reach the MQTT broker
connection.blocked: Save and test the connection to continue, or choose “Set up later”.
connection.later_note: No Frigate or broker to hand? Choose “Set up later”. Until both are connected under Settings → Cameras & connection, no visits arrive, no photos or clips can be fetched, and the cameras step cannot list your cameras.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description: Choose which Frigate cameras YA-WAMF watches. Finer control over what is kept is in Settings → Identifying birds.
cameras.gates_hint: Seeing fewer birds here than in Frigate? Frigate decides which snapshots it sends, before YA-WAMF sees anything.
cameras.list_unread: Frigate's camera list could not be read, so these names cannot be checked. A name that does not match exactly never sees a bird. Leave this empty to watch every camera.
cameras.list_timed_out: Frigate did not answer within {seconds} seconds, so these names cannot be checked. A name that does not match exactly never sees a bird. Leave this empty to watch every camera.
cameras.reading: Asking Frigate for its cameras, for up to {seconds} seconds. You can continue without waiting: the cameras already saved stay as they are.
cameras.not_in_frigate: Frigate has no camera with this name, so it will never see a bird.
cameras.watching_all: Watching every camera, including any you add to Frigate later. Tick cameras to watch only those.
cameras.watching_some: {count, plural, one {Watching # camera.} other {Watching # cameras.}} Other cameras are ignored.

model.title: Model and hardware
model.description: Choose the model that names the birds. Download it here if this install does not have it, then check that it runs on this machine before continuing.
model.download_required: Download this model first. Then check that it runs on this machine.
model.download_timeout: The download is taking longer than expected. Check the connection and try again.
model.validation_timeout: The check has run for more than 30 minutes. It may still be finishing: look under Model evaluation before starting another.
model.provider_hint: Only the devices this install can use for the chosen model are listed.
model.save_error: The model choice could not be saved. Check that YA-WAMF is running, then try again.
model.sweep_error: The check could not be started. Check that YA-WAMF is running, then try again.
model.validate: Check it runs on this machine
model.validation_required: Check that this model runs on this machine before continuing.
model.validation_success: The check finished: this model runs on this machine.
model.location_hint: Checking or continuing saves these coordinates first. They are the same feeder location as Settings → Sharing & integrations → Location. This model does not use the date or an accuracy radius.
model.location_incomplete: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
model.location_empty: No location will be used: this model identifies birds without it.
model.phase_sweep: Checking this model on each device…
model.region_no_country: No country is saved, so Auto uses the North American species list. Choose Europe if your feeder is in Europe.
model.region_chosen: This model will use the species list for {region}.
model.region_from_country: Your saved country selects the species list for {region}.
model.incomplete_install: This model install is incomplete. Download and verify it again before continuing.
model.check_running: Continue is available when the check finishes. Leaving this step does not stop the check. Return later to read the saved results.
model.provider_replaced: {previous} did not pass the check for this model, so {provider} is selected instead.
model.no_passing_provider: This model did not pass the check. Review the results and try again before continuing.
model.readiness_retry: The check finished, but model readiness could not be refreshed. Retrying; you can leave this step and return later.
model.best_provider: Best device that passed: {provider}, {ms} ms a photo
model.blocked_downloading: Continue is available when the download finishes.
model.blocked_no_model: Choose a model to continue, or skip this step to keep the model in use now.
model.blocked_download: Download this model to continue, or skip this step to keep the model in use now.
model.blocked_check: Check that this model runs on this machine to continue, or skip this step to keep the model in use now.
model.blocked_location: Enter the feeder’s latitude and longitude to continue, or leave both empty.
model.blocked_provider: This host does not have the chosen device. Choose another, or Auto, to continue.

quality.title: Best available snapshots
quality.description: After each visit, YA-WAMF can choose the clearest frame from the recording and the best close-up of the bird.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.birdnet_test_subtitle: The test uses this address, then checks the saved MQTT broker and that calls can be stored.
integrations.description: Optional add-ons. Turn on what you want now; the final review marks any that still need a key or an account.
integrations.note_ai: Behavioural notes. Add a provider key in Settings.
integrations.note_birdnet: Confirms what the camera saw with what the microphone heard.
integrations.note_bw: Report to community stations. Add a station token in Settings.
integrations.note_ebird: Nearby sightings, maps and an optional range filter. Add an API key in Settings.
integrations.note_inat: Owner-reviewed submissions. Connect your account in Settings.
integrations.notifications_note: Notification channels are configured under Settings → Alerts. Home Assistant is installed and configured externally; see the integration guide.

history.title: Import visits Frigate still has
history.description: Optionally name the bird events Frigate still keeps. The import runs in the background while you finish setup.
history.enable: Import the bird events Frigate still keeps
history.enable_help: A visit already in your history is changed only when the new result is better; its saved audio and weather stay.
history.audio_note: Frigate’s history can bring back visits and their photos, but not BirdNET-Go audio that was never stored.
